description: This file defines and manages various memory embedding provider adapters, including creation, registration, and metadata functions for different embedding services like OpenAI, Gemini, Voyage, Mistral, Ollama, and local providers. It includes utility functions for error handling, header sanitization, and support checks for multimodal embeddings.

classes.name: BuiltinMemoryEmbeddingProviderDoctorMetadata
classes.description: Type defining metadata for memory embedding providers, including provider ID, environment variables, transport type, and auto-select priority.

classes.name: MemoryEmbeddingProviderAdapter
classes.description: Interface for embedding provider adapters, including properties like id, defaultModel, transport, autoSelectPriority, and methods for creation and error formatting.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error object into a string message.

methods.name: isMissingApiKeyError
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a missing API key.

methods.name: sanitizeHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes headers by removing excluded headers and sorting them.

methods.name: mapBatchEmbeddingsByIndex
methods.description: Maps batch embeddings by index from a map of custom IDs to indices.

methods.name: isNodeLlamaCppMissing
methods.description: Detects if an error is due to missing node-llama-cpp module.

methods.name: formatLocalSetupError
methods.description: Formats error messages related to local embedding setup issues.

methods.name: canAutoSelectLocal
methods.description: Determines if local model can be auto-selected based on path and file existence.

methods.name: supportsGeminiMultimodalEmbeddings
methods.description: Checks if a Gemini model supports multimodal embeddings.

methods.name: resolveMemoryEmbeddingAuthProviderId
methods.description: Resolves the authentication provider ID for a given provider.

methods.name: getBuiltinMemoryEmbeddingProviderAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves a provider adapter by its ID.

methods.name: registerBuiltInMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Registers built-in memory embedding providers if not already registered.

methods.name: getBuiltinMemoryEmbeddingProviderDoctorMetadata
methods.description: Gets metadata for a provider suitable for doctor diagnostics.

methods.name: listBuiltinAutoSelectMemoryEmbeddingProviderDoctorMetadata
methods.description: Lists metadata for auto-selectable built-in providers, sorted by priority.
